T: Fat guy in a little coat.
D: A dim but lovable heir hits the road with a grumpy salesman to save the family brake pad business.
P: Serve the wings when Tommy talks the diner waitress into reopening the kitchen.
S: the kitchen's closed, Tommy wants wings
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, blue cheese dip and celery.
chocolate and peanut butter, Ohio's own sweet
Peanut butter, butter and icing sugar rolled into balls, chilled, dipped in dark chocolate leaving a round of peanut butter showing.
the jacket rips at the seams
Sausage mince with onion and herbs wrapped in puff pastry that's slightly too small, so it splits in the oven. Baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
M: Beef simmered loose with tomato, cinnamon, cumin, allspice and a square of dark chocolate for 90 minutes, ladled over spaghetti and buried in finely grated cheddar.
for the factory crew in Sandusky
Thick sausages and chuck burgers grilled over coals, corn on the cob brushed with butter, coleslaw with a creamy vinegar dressing.
W: Cherry pie with a lattice top, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, vanilla ice cream.
K: Tommy and Richard on the road
American lager ice cold in the bottle at the motel.

s.note: chocolate and peanut butter, Ohio's own sweet
s.how: Beat 250g smooth peanut butter with 60g soft butter and 200g icing sugar, roll into 24 small balls and chill 30 minutes. Melt 200g dark chocolate, dip each ball on a toothpick leaving a round of peanut butter showing at the top, set on baking paper in the fridge for 20 minutes.

s.note: the kitchen's closed, Tommy wants wings
s.how: Pat 1kg chicken wings dry and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 40g butter. Mix 80g blue cheese with 125g sour cream for a dip and serve with celery sticks.

m.how: Simmer 600g beef mince in 750ml water, breaking it up fine. Add 1 diced onion, 400g crushed tomatoes, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp allspice, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 15g dark chocolate. Simmer 90 minutes until thick. Ladle over 400g cooked spaghetti and pile 200g finely grated cheddar on top.

w.how: Toss 800g pitted cherries with 150g sugar and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more sheets. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Tommy and Richard on the road
d.how: Chill eight 355ml bottles of American lager for at least three hours, or in a motel sink full of ice for 30 minutes. Drink straight from the bottle on the end of the bed.
